name: International Conference on Automation, Robotics and Applications
note: In recent years, the field of automation and robotics has experienced significant advancements, revolutionizing industries and shaping the future of technology. Automation involves the use of technology to perform tasks with minimal human intervention, while Robotics focuses on the design and development of intelligent machines capable of interacting with the physical world. The rapid development of automation and robotics has been fueled by advancements in key technologies such as sensors, actuators, control systems, machine learning, computer vision, and human-robot interaction. These technologies have enabled the creation of autonomous systems that can perceive their environment, make decisions, and execute tasks efficiently.

name: International Symposium on Heterogeneous and Multi-Domain Systems
note: An international scientific symposium on modeling, integration, coordination, and operation of systems spanning multiple engineering and computational domains.

name: ACM/IEEE International Conference on Human-Robot Interaction
IEEE-RAS International Conference on Soft Robotics
note: The theme for the 10th IEEE International Conference on Soft Robotics (Robosoft27) centres on “Soft Robotics in the Wild”, emphasizing both the source of endless bioinspiration that drives our field, and the ongoing maturation of soft robotics technology into deployment in tough natural environments.

name: Symposium on Applied Computing - Intelligent Robotics and Multi-Agent Systems
note: The ACM Symposium on Applied Computing (SAC) has been a primary gathering forum for applied computer scientists, computer engineers, software engineers, and application developers from around the world. SAC 2027 is sponsored by the ACM Special Interest Group on Applied Computing (SIGAPP), and will be held in Gwangju, South Korea. In SAC 2015, the technical track on Intelligent Robotics and Multi-Agent Systems (IRMAS) joined the former tracks on Intelligent Robotic Systems (ROBOT) and Cooperative Multi-Agent Systems and Applications (CMASA) which had been organized as separate technical tracks in past editions of SAC. The IRMAS track will be organized for the thirteenth time in SAC 2027, exploiting the inherent synergy between Robotics and Multi-Agent Systems (MAS), thus aiming to bring together these highly related and exciting research fields.

name: 8th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Robotics and Control
note: AIRC brings together researchers and engineers working across AI, robotics, and control systems, including topics such as machine learning, computer vision, autonomous systems, collaborative and humanoid robots, and the integration of control with AI and IoT. Accepted and registered papers are peer-reviewed and published in the conference proceedings. Recent AIRC proceedings have been indexed in IEEE Xplore, Ei Compendex, and Scopus.

name: International Symposium on Medical Robotics
note: The 2027 International Symposium on Medical Robotics (ISMR) will be held in Nashville, Tennessee, at Vanderbilt University from April 27-29, 2027. The symposium will begin with the workshop(s)/tutorial(s) held on April 27, and the subsequent single-track symposium presentations from April 28-29. This symposium will feature invited talks and workshops in addition to single-track oral/poster presentations of original research.

name: IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation
Conference on Cognitive & Computational Aspects of Situation Management
note: Now in its 17th edition, CogSIMA brings together researchers across AI and machine learning, cognitive science, human factors and ergonomics, robotics and autonomous systems, information fusion, modeling and simulation, and systems engineering to advance the interdisciplinary study of situation awareness, situation assessment, and cognitive situation management.

name: AI & Robotics Odyssey
note: AIRodyssey is a single-track residential conference bringing AI and robotics researchers together for four days, with one thematic day

name: The 38th IEEE Intelligent Vehicles Symposium
note: The IEEE Intelligent Vehicles Symposium is a premier forum sponsored by the IEEE Intelligent Transportation Systems Society (ITSS). Researchers, engineers, practitioners, and students from industry, universities, and government agencies are invited to present their latest work and to discuss research and applications for Intelligent Vehicles and Vehicle–Infrastructure Cooperation. The conference offers technical sessions, workshops, poster sessions, exhibitions, and more.

name: Learning for Dynamics and Control Conference
International Conference on Reconfigurable Mechanisms and Robots
note: The conference brings together researchers, engineers, and practitioners from academia and industry to exchange the latest developments in theory, design, modelling, analysis, control, and applications of reconfigurable mechanisms and robots. ReMAR2027 aims to foster interdisciplinary collaboration across robotics, mechanism science, manufacturing, deployable structures, soft robotics, engineering origami, and adaptive systems.

name: IEEE/ASME International Conference on Advanced Intelligent Mechatronics
note: This meeting not only provides a platform for dissemination and discussion of the state-of-the-art in research but also creates opportunities for networking with colleagues from around the world. The conference features conference awards, contributed sessions, invited sessions, tutorial workshops, special sessions, plenary talks, student programs, as well as committee meetings, industry programs, and social functions.

name: International Conference on Cable-Driven Parallel Robots
Robotics: Science and System
IEEE 23rd International Conference on Advanced Robotics
note: Since 1983, ICAR has led the way in robotics innovation. A comprehensive range of robotics issues, including robotic vision, cognitive robotics, humanoid robots, and many more, will be covered through oral presentations, practical workshops, and plenary speeches by well-known specialists. ICAR has always been a driving force behind innovative contributions, ground-breaking concepts, and novel viewpoints that push the limits of robotics technology and research. This edition will focus on DEEP TECH ROBOTICS AND EMBODIED AI and will target the issues and opportunities – for research and science-driven innovation – of applying AI to Robotics, in particular for biomedical robotics, biorobotics, soft robotics and the intertwining of them. We will provide a gathering occasion for a large bustling area spanning from an Austro-Hungarian mittel-europa to the Adriatic , the southern Slavic countries, Greece and Turkey. We will offer a stage to local unicorns and technology companies.

name: European Conference on Mobile Robots
note: The European Conference on Mobile Robots (ECMR) is a well-established biennial conference in the area of mobile robotics and mobile human-robot systems. The 13th edition takes place at the Thessaloniki Olympic Museum, Greece, including workshops and tutorials on 31 August and the main conference on 1-3 September 2027.

name: Conference on Agricultural Robotics and Automation
note: The Conference on Agricultural Robotics and Automation aims to bring together researchers working on both fundamental developments in robotics and automation and their application in agriculture.

name: ROS Conference
IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems
note: Human-centric robotics development is a mandatory challenge for real deployment of cooperative, trustworthy and acceptable robotic solutions and services. Digital transformation will also involve robotics, favoring synergies with artificial intelligence and IOT and spreading their use in every daily life environments. Robotics for sustainability in today’s world is a promising challenge to address climate change, enhance recycling, make manufacturing, mobility, food and daily life more and more.
